description: The nodes reporting to the status page: name (operator-chosen for verified nodes, a pseudonym such as node-3f9a2c1b otherwise; untrusted), verified, client version, online/offline (and since when), syncing, mining and hashrate, peers, peer latency (ms), best block, propagation delay of the last block (left out when it was not timed: a block the node caught up to after connecting or while syncing) and on average (ms), pending transactions, uptime (%) and country (IP addresses and cities are never published). Offline nodes are left out unless include_offline=true; verified_only=true keeps only operator-verified nodes. The status page covers the nodes that report to it (run with --prlstats), not every node on the network; unverified nodes' rows are self-reported.

include_offline.description: also list nodes that are offline

name: network_nodes
title: Reporting nodes
